verdict.rationale: MoonPay publishes a structured API reference with endpoint pages (quotes, sessions, webhooks) and an OpenAPI spec for codegen. Runnable examples are available through a clone-able Demo Integrations repo plus test mode and a sandbox. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive (no 'try it' console), and probing common OpenAPI paths returned 404. Missing for 10: an evidenced in-browser interactive API explorer, runnable request examples embedded in the reference pages, a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec URL, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
